text: I've been trying to get through for the best part of an hour now and kept getting cut off so I'm trying this instead. My stepson is 11 and his temperature is 39.3, I've checked it twice with two different thermometers because his dad didn't believe the first one. He was sick once earlier this evening, just the once, and since then he's had squash and water and it's all stayed down, no more vomiting at all. He's sat on the sofa wrapped in a blanket moaning that he feels rubbish, which honestly is fair enough. His mum normally deals with this sort of thing and she isn't answering, his dad's at work until late, so it's landed on me. I've given him the usual dose of paracetamol for his age about forty minutes ago. What I actually need to know is whether this is a ride it out at home overnight situation or whether I'm meant to be doing something else, because nobody has given me a straight answer yet and I'd quite like one before midnight.
